test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Ram was sitting on a tree and was eating an apple.

B. The monkey had thrown an apple at him.

C. While eating the apple, something hit his head.

D. He looked up to find a monkey sitting on a branch of the tree.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **ACDB**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct order of sentences to form a coherent paragraph is** ACDB.**
 
• **Sentence A** establishes the context that Ram is sit
